beats.s0b0: Unlike a straight line, a smooth curve changes its steepness from point to point.
beats.s0b1: At any single point, the tangent line just touches the curve and matches its direction.
beats.s0b2: The slope of this tangent line is the derivative, written f prime of x.
beats.s1b0: Slide the point along the curve: while it climbs, the tangent tilts up and the derivative is positive.
beats.s1b1: Right at the peak, the tangent line goes completely flat, so the derivative is zero.
beats.s1b2: Past the peak, the curve falls and the slope turns negative, tracing out the derivative function.
